coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 5 ground-truth variable items (40%): JaxMARL/SMAX with a specified common hardware setup, and elapsed training time to a defined performance criterion. Timing in seconds rather than minutes is a convertible unit difference.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The algorithm conditions use IPPO/SPPO and primarily IQL, rather than MAPPO and QMIX; QMIX is only optional. The task set contains four proposed maps rather than nine selected by excluding maps with more than 10 units. Normalized score subtracts a random-policy baseline and permits an observed reference ceiling, rather than dividing the algorithm score by the scenario maximum.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing both expected findings: PPO trains approximately 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios because of greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
